QuestInfo.name: Knighthood Exam: Wind Archer
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take your Knighthood Exam if you see #b#p1101005##k, the Chief Knight of the Wind. Better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101005#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. You just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032098#. Better find #b30 #t4032098#s#k and bring them back to #p1101005# \n\n#i4032098# #t4032098# #b#c4032098# / 30#k
QuestInfo.2: You have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the 'in-Training' from your title. As a bona fide Cygnus Knight, do your best to work hard so you will never be ashamed of yourself.

0.0: Knighthood Exam... I suppose it's your turn to take it now. Based on your contributions to the Cygnus Knights, it only makes sense. Okay, I will grant you the right to take the Knighthood Exam. Are you ready?

yes.0: The test is actually quite easy. Remember the Training Forest in which you trained back in the day? At the end of it, you'll find #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k. There, your job is to defeat the Mimis and bring back #b30 #t4032098#s#k in return.
yes.1: If you can bring all the #t4032098#s, then I will grant you the right to become a Knight. At this point, I need your skills to do the talking.

no.0: If you have the slightest of hesitation, it's good to dust them off first before taking on the test.

item.0: I don't think you have brought #b30 #t4032098#s#k yet. Go to the end of the Training Forest. There, inside #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, you'll need to find #t4032098#...
